scope: Original package comparison and integrated audited resolution

rows.impact: Repeated definitions need physical qualification (04).
rows.canonicalResolution: Stable PX IDs; typed unique registries; Endpoint(instanceId,interfaceId).

rows.impact: Identity and source claims are separated from meshes.
rows.canonicalResolution: Retain definition revisions and explicit applicability.

rows.impact: Inventory identity is not rendering allocation.
rows.canonicalResolution: One physical identity; owned elements remain with purchased owner.

rows.impact: Private images and printed observations have bounded authority.
rows.canonicalResolution: Keep revision/hash/location/privacy/scope; no inferred physical inventory.

rows.impact: Official approximate or generic source cannot self-admit.
rows.canonicalResolution: Retain source limitations and proven V40 applicability.

rows.impact: Bare feature ID may bind wrong reused servo.
rows.canonicalResolution: Physical refs are Endpoint; reusable runtime local frames use definitionId+interfaceId.

rows.impact: Interface-keyed coordinates collide across parts.
rows.canonicalResolution: Key by connectionId+DOF, with typed units/remaining-DOF validation.

rows.impact: Patch references lacked IDs; S27 front parent was wrong.
rows.canonicalResolution: Identified deterministic patches; S27 chassis/rear-drive in human and JSON.

rows.impact: Routes/allocations/group state cannot survive complete snapshot serialization.
rows.canonicalResolution: Explicit complete state collections; hash is derived, not storage replacement.

rows.impact: Unqualified anchor and unbounded path proof.
rows.canonicalResolution: Endpoint anchor, admitted path scope, independent swept bounds.

rows.impact: No stable patch ID/splice semantics.
rows.canonicalResolution: At most one patch per step/variant; nonempty contiguous replacement span.

rows.impact: No typed expected operand or execution phase.
rows.canonicalResolution: predicateVersion/evaluationPhase/expected plus fixed registry.

rows.impact: VERIFIED transcription is not engineering proof.
rows.canonicalResolution: Exactly VERIFIED/DERIVED/PROBABLE/UNRESOLVED; source scope propagates.

rows.impact: A completed mesh must not upgrade evidence confidence.
rows.canonicalResolution: Retain distinct maturity and confidence axes.

rows.impact: Method and conflict closure otherwise require ad hoc records.
rows.canonicalResolution: Typed DerivationRecord/ConflictRecord; immutable method/source chain.

rows.impact: Unconditional meshHash requires future output before export.
rows.canonicalResolution: Pre-export mesh notApplicable; upstream real hashes required.

rows.impact: PASS could carry blockers/empty scope; oracle coverage unspecified.
rows.canonicalResolution: Nonempty complete scope, empty blockers, final-byte witnesses and path/LOD limits.

rows.impact: Consumer cannot resolve all graph/solution dependencies.
rows.canonicalResolution: Typed RuntimeRegistry, CompiledGraph and AssemblySolution artifacts; trusted admission chain.

rows.impact: Blocked PDF could be misread as M0 accepted.
rows.canonicalResolution: All29 mapped panels and real SHA required; M1 forbidden until A–G pass.

rows.impact: Cross-variant graph or zeroing record can be accidentally reused.
rows.canonicalResolution: Session pins one variant graph; explicit fork/adoption and attestation invalidation.

rows.impact: Existing key/fields were correctly identified.
rows.canonicalResolution: Preserve raw picarx.v1; actual fields steps/checks/lastRoute/pdfLastPage.

rows.impact: Lost acknowledgment retry can fail CAS or duplicate effects.
rows.canonicalResolution: Stored requestHash/result checked before CAS; transactionally authoritative events.

rows.impact: Free text cannot enforce fresh servo/procedure/epoch eligibility.
rows.canonicalResolution: Structured acknowledgments/zeroing attestations; no sensed-state claim.

rows.impact: A provisional model may still look convincing.
rows.canonicalResolution: Explicit review-only; never satisfies G-GEOMETRY for production instructions.

rows.impact: Useful guidance may exist before metric geometry.
rows.canonicalResolution: Text/photos remain available; unverified geometry does not receive placement authority.

rows.impact: Basis permutation is right-handed, not reflection.
translationMm schema reused in metre runtime.
rows.canonicalResolution: Distinct RuntimeTransform translationM; no silent unit interpretation.

rows.impact: World/local solution convention and stable lookup missing.
rows.canonicalResolution: Typed absolute world poses, exactly one conversion; no double parent transform.

rows.impact: Advertised LOD nodes not explicitly enumerated.
rows.canonicalResolution: Exact node sets per LOD, definition/element ownership, physical root mapping.

rows.impact: Mutable decoder or undeclared resource can bypass byte binding.
rows.canonicalResolution: AvailableArtifact paths/hash/size/media; decode exactly verified bytes.

rows.impact: Appearance variants can collide at one modelHash directory.
rows.canonicalResolution: modelHash is mechanical inputs; immutable publication/cache uses packHash.

rows.impact: Singular root graph versus three compiled variants ambiguous.
rows.canonicalResolution: graphSetHash aggregates; sessions/solutions/reports bind selected graphHash.

rows.impact: Exact preimage/closure needed to invalidate the right proof.
rows.canonicalResolution: JCS scoped source projection, raw source bytes separately hashed.

rows.impact: Unreleased contract revision and storage upgrade could be conflated.
rows.canonicalResolution: Canonical schema contractv2; historicv1 not runtime; DB migration remains M3.

rows.impact: Unspecified self/downstream hashes can become circular.
rows.canonicalResolution: Materialized graph input excludes self hashes and generated solutions; referenced instruction inputs included.

rows.impact: Re-upgrade can reimport edited stale legacy values.
rows.canonicalResolution: Migration identity and LEGACY_DIVERGENCE; no automatic detailed-state merge.

rows.impact: Independent roots/DB WAL break naive copies.
rows.canonicalResolution: Journal+leases for content; immutable pack pointer; verified logical/consistent DB backup.

rows.impact: Symbolic cut lengths and lot remaining state absent.
rows.canonicalResolution: Typed unknown amount allowed; quantitative conservation BLOCKED until supported.

rows.impact: Fixture success can be mistaken for real-part acceptance.
rows.canonicalResolution: Preserve15-node DAG;18-phase plan and scoped receipts.

rows.impact: Ignored local files may still ship, or be deleted in sanitization.
rows.canonicalResolution: Preserve originals and use safe dev/build mirror plus packaging checks.
